name: 06-tired-reps-return-135
description: Simulated, 30 fps, 1 px noise. Tired reps (75°) that only come back up to a 135° elbow (RepSpec.returnElbowDeg; d ≈ 0.08, above upThreshold), then two shallow reps from that tired top: 115° (turns back early: live "Go lower") and 120° (ends back at the tired top before turning back 0.04 below its peak: "Go lower" at the top, partial live = false); more tired reps, a full rep, then a bounce part of the way up (70° → 120° → 70° → top) that counts once, not twice. 6 reps, 2 partials, nothing cancelled. targetReps 30.
